title: Velocity Averaging for the Wigner Equation with Electromagnetic Fields
summary: We discuss the application of $L^2$-based velocity averaging to the Wigner kinetic equation governing the quantum evolution of the Wigner transform of a density operator of a particle subjected to an external electromagnetic field. This extends the $L^2$-based averaging lemma from [F. Golse, J. Möller: Commun. Math. Sci. (2026)] to electromagnetic fields. We make use of the magnetic or gauge-invariant Wigner transform due to Stratonovich [Sov. Phys.
